faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for promotional products?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product type. Many items start at just 24-50 pieces, while apparel typically requires 12-24 pieces. Some premium gifts and tech items may have higher minimums. Contact us for specific product details—we can help you find options that fit your budget and quantity needs.

We offer multiple decoration methods to match your product and design: screen printing and embroidery for apparel; laser engraving for metal and wood items; debossing and embossing for leather and premium products; full-color digital printing for complex designs; and pad printing for pens and small items. Our team recommends the best method for your specific project.

faqs.q: How long does it take to receive promotional products?
faqs.a: Standard production time is typically 5-10 business days after artwork approval, plus shipping time. Rush production is available for many products (additional fees may apply). Complex orders or large quantities may require additional time. We'll provide a clear timeline when you request your estimate.

faqs.q: Can you help with product selection and design?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our team provides product recommendations based on your goals, budget, and timeline. In-house designers create or refine your artwork to ensure optimal decoration results. Whether you have existing brand guidelines or need creative development, we handle every detail to deliver impactful branded merchandise.

faqs.q: Do you offer fulfillment and shipping services?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide complete fulfillment services including kitting, custom packaging, and shipping to multiple locations. Promotional products can be integrated with print and mail campaigns for cohesive marketing initiatives. Store and release programs are also available for ongoing employee or client gifting needs.

faqs.q: What is the process for obtaining a free estimate?
faqs.a: Simply submit details through our contact form, email orders@broadstrokeinc.com, or call 316-262-3333. A member of our team will review your project and provide a clear, no-obligation estimate with recommended products, decoration methods, and timelines.
